purpose: Additive China resource-site expansion. Original 199-site files remain unchanged; runtime merges this extension into canonical catalog, reserve simulation, evidence index, scenario capacity and map binding.
provenancePolicy: Published facts retain sources and measurement year. Unknown grade, purity, recoverable reserve, real reserve, throughput and rates remain UNOBSERVED. ESTIMATED_* coordinates are map proxies, not surveyed points. reserveRecords/scenarioRecords are gameplay assumptions, not real-world quantities.
